chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Al-Nadr, from 'Asim, from Abi Basir, from Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a man who married a woman in absentia and had not seen her, then he accused her [of unchastity]. He said: “He is to be flogged.”

key_terms.امْرَأَةً: a woman; the wife in question
key_terms.غَائِبَةً: absent; not physically present at the time of marriage
key_terms.فَقَذَفَهَا: then he accused her of unchastity/slandered her
key_terms.يُجْلَدُ: he is to be flogged as a legal punishment

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man accuses a wife he married in absentia of unchastity?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning false accusation against a wife whom a man married without having seen. The Imam عليه السلام rules that if he slanders her with such an accusation, the prescribed punishment is to be carried out against him.
